children: Samsung Electronics (SSNLF), the Korean memory-chip, foundry and consumer-electronics powerhouse, expanded its OpenAI relationship across advanced processors and enterprise artificial intelligence. The shares closed 3.5% lower at 259,500 won Friday, showing investors want commercial resultsnot another AI headline.

OpenAI Korea highlighted progress in chip manufacturing and research while describing Samsung as one of ChatGPT's largest corporate users. The excitement quickly cooled. OpenAI later said the remarks covered existing cooperation, including Samsung's internal AI adoption and an earlier letter of intent, with no new agreement announced.

Demand is certainly roaring: South Korean ChatGPT Enterprise usage has surged 28-fold in one year. Samsung's GF Score of 92/100 reinforces the bullish fundamentals, with outstanding growth, financial strength and profitability alongside solid momentumbut a noticeably weaker GF Value rating. The collaboration could eventually unlock chip orders and productivity gains, yet without firm production commitments, it remains strategic upside rather than revenue investors can count today.

title: Samsung Drops 3.5% While OpenAI Chip Work Still Lacks a Contract
